text:
taylor_ops: :rotating_light: Seeing a spike in fncall and structured-output errors since 02:05 UTC. P50 latencies fine but error rate on tool invocation path up ~6x. Affects hosted tier primarily.

marta_sre: grabbing metrics now — looks correlated with a burst of small chat completions that trigger tool call logic. KV cache hit rate dropped for a subset of instances.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — ID INC-20260315-98. Severity: SEV2. Paging eng-sre oncall.

ravi_k: oncall here. Can you paste the query you used for the fncall errors? I want traces.

marta_sre: Query: `sum(rate(server_errors_total{route=~"/v1/.*call.*"}[1m])) by (instance)` — top instances: gpu-04, gpu-09.

jen-product: Customers reporting malformed JSON responses when model returns structured output + function call. Is this the same issue?

taylor_ops: Yes. When the tool orchestration fails mid-stream we end up with truncated JSON payload in structured-output mode. User impact: some jobs return 4xx client errors, others 5xx. Early estimate: ~120 tenants impacted, mostly free/hosted.

ravi_k: Priority mitigation: disable structured-output heuristics and restrict fncall for hosted tier while we investigate. We should keep dedicated customers on, unless they report issues.

marta_sre: Agreed. Plan: (1) Toggle global flag to route structured-output requests to legacy serializer. (2) Apply soft rate-limit of 10 rps per tenant for fncall path on hosted. (3) Post customer comms if >1h.

taylor_ops: I'll run the toggle for (1) now. Running command: 
```
kubectl exec -n inference control-plane-0 -- curl -X POST http://localhost:9001/admin/feature-toggle \
  -d '{"structured_output_mode":"legacy"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

incident-bot: ACTION LOGGED: feature-toggle requested by taylor_ops at 1718200060

marta_sre: Verified config change rolled to control-plane-0..3. Patch is hot. Monitoring errors.

ravi_k: For (2) can you apply per-tenant token bucket with burst=2, rate=10 on the fncall gateway? Command: `rctl apply rate --path /fncall --scope hosted --rate 10/s --burst 2`

taylor_ops: Running rctl... output: 
```
Applying rate-limit to gateway-hosted
rule id: rl-20260315-3
status: applied
```

jen-product: Noting this will increase 429 responses for aggressive agent frameworks. We should surface a clear 429 body explaining temporary mitigation.

marta_sre: Pushing a 429 template now. Patch: `fncall-temporary-throttle` with retry-after header.

incident-bot: NOTIFICATION SENT to #status-pages: "Temporary fncall rate limiting in effect for hosted tier; structured output serialized via legacy path. Potentially increased 429s for heavy agent traffic. Investigating."

customer-success: Received first inbound from a mid-market customer complaining about repeated 429 causing job retries. They want ETA.

ravi_k: Please escalate to account lead; we need to confirm if they're on Dedicated — if Dedicated, we can exempt them.

customer-success: Confirmed: customer is hosted. Escalated. They're ok with soft throttle if we ETA the fix.

taylor_ops: Observing immediate drop in fncall error rate by ~40% after legacy toggle and rate limit. Still seeing intermittent truncated outputs for long streaming calls.

marta_sre: Root suspicion: a race in the streaming state machine when tool orchestration times out and the structured serializer attempts to close JSON ahead of final token. Switching to legacy avoids the new serializer's edge-case.

ravi_k: Next steps: (A) keep current mitigations, (B) backfill a safety timeout on the serializer path in canary, (C) prepare rollback plan if error rate worsens. Who can work on (B)?

jen-product: I'll pair with alex from runtime to draft the timeout patch and a unit test. Target: canary in 30m.

taylor_ops: I'm going to add a temporary tenant-exemption list for sensitive customers: `rl-20260315-3:exempt=tenant_453,tenant_772` — applying now.


marta_sre: Exemptions applied. Verified traffic for tenant_453 now bypasses fncall throttle.

incident-bot: Handoff scheduled: Oncall shift change at +45m. ravi_k please hand off to next oncall (marta_sre).

ravi_k: Acknowledged. Marta, I will summarise current state: mitigations applied (legacy serializer + hosted fncall rate-limit), partial exemptions added, error rate dropped but not back to baseline, ongoing fix in dev for streaming safety timeout.

marta_sre: Got it. Will monitor dashboards for the next hour. If error rate <2x baseline in 30m, we'll move to alert-only and draft customer update.

customer-success: Can we add a short note to the impacted customers saying: "We've applied temporary throttling to improve platform stability. If you see 429s, please retry after the Retry-After window. We'll post updates in 1 hour."

ravi_k: Good. customer-success please send that now. Use the incident ID.

customer-success: Sent initial comms to the affected list.

jen-product: Canary build with safety timeout submitted: PR #5132. Change: serializer now waits up to 2s for final token on fncall stream before closing JSON; falls back to graceful abort marker if backend doesn't respond.

marta_sre: Nice. Schedule canary rollout to 2% traffic in region-us-west. Use tag `canary/stream-safety-2s`.

taylor_ops: Rolling canary. Command: `deployctl promote canary/stream-safety-2s --percent 2 --region us-west`

incident-bot: CANARY DEPLOYED to 2% at 1718200265. Watch traces for streaming-json-close events.

marta_sre: Early canary traces show a reduction in truncated payloads for canary instances. Good signal.

ravi_k: If canary remains stable for 20m, we can promote to 25% and start de-escalation. Keep throttles in place until stability confirmed.

customer-success: Updated customers with ETA: 1-2 hours for full remediation. Keeping them in the loop.

taylor_ops: I'll keep a short running timeline in case we need to revert: current mitigation ids: rl-20260315-3, feature-toggle structured_output=legacy.

marta_sre: Handing off active monitoring to night shift. I'll follow up on the promotion in 20m and confirm rollback plan if error rate spikes.

ravi_k: Thanks all. If anything regresses, page immediately and use "INC-20260315-98" in subject.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: status=mitigated, mitigations=[legacy_serializer, hosted_fncall_rate_limit], last_updated=1718200360

jen-product: :white_check_mark: Leaving notes in the PR about tenant exemptions and monitor playbook.

marta_sre: Closing the thread for handoff. Continuing watch separately.
